original: ふんふんふふ〜〜ん♪
traducao: Hmm-hmm-hmmm~

original: ちょっと、どこ見て歩いてるのよ？\n危ないじゃない！
traducao: Hey, watch where you're going!\nThat's dangerous!

original: ご、ごめんなさい……。\nちょっと、道に迷っちゃって……
traducao: I-I'm so sorry...\nI kind of got lost...

original: そういえば、見ない顔ね……。\n新しくここに来た人？
traducao: Come to think of it, I don't know you...\nAre you new here?

original: うん。\n今度からここで\nお世話になる事になったんだ
traducao: Yeah.\nI'm going to be staying here\nfrom now on.

original: 私、コレット・ブルーネルだよ。\nよろしくね
traducao: I'm Colette Brunel.\nNice to meet you!

original: ど……どうして私が、\nよろしくしなくちゃいけないの
traducao: W-Why should I have to be\nnice to you?!

original: ……そっか。\nそだよね、ごめんね
traducao: ...Oh, right.\nYou're right, I'm sorry.

original: ちょ、ちょっと。\n何で謝ってんのよ？
traducao: H-Hey!\nWhat are you apologizing for?!

original: …………、\n……マルタ・ルアルディ。\nマルタでいいよ
traducao: ......\n...I'm Marta Lualdi.\nJust Marta is fine.

original: それで、コレットはどこに行きたかったの？\nついでだから、私が案内してあげる
traducao: Where did you want to go, Colette?\nI might as well show you the way.

original: 本当？　ありがとう！\nマルタはいい人だね
traducao: Really? Thank you!\nYou're so nice, Marta.

original: お友達になれて嬉しいな
traducao: I'm so happy we could be friends!

original: だ、誰と誰が友達なのよっ？\nもう、この子、何か調子狂う……
traducao: W-Who said we were friends?!\nJeez, this girl totally throws me off...

original: コレット……だっけ？\n何かあの子、変わってるわよねー
traducao: Colette... was it?\nThere's something weird about her, huh?

original: ドンくさいっていうか、鈍いっていうか。\nなんっか見ててイライラすんのよねー
traducao: Clumsy, slow on the uptake...\nJust watching her gets on my nerves!

original: ちょっと、コレットの事悪く言わないでよね！\n確かにあの子はドンくさいし鈍いし天然だし
traducao: Hey, don't badmouth Colette!\nSure, she is clumsy, slow, and an airhead,

original: すぐ転ぶしバカみたいにお人好しだし\n犬にネコって名前付けたりするけど
traducao: she falls over, is ridiculously nice,\nand even names her dog 'Cat', but...

original: でも……あの子はいい子なんだから！
traducao: Still... she really is a good person!

original: ちょっとちょっと。\n何マジになって怒ってるワケ？
traducao: Whoa, hold on.\nWhy are you getting so worked up?

original: っていうか、マルタだって\nいっつもコレットにつっかかってんじゃない！
traducao: I mean, Marta, aren't you always\npicking fights with Colette yourself?!

original: 私はいいの！\nだって、コレットと私は……
traducao: That's different!\nBecause Colette and I are...

original: あれっ、イリアとマルタ？\n二人とも、どしたの？
traducao: Oh, Iria and Marta?\nWhat are you two doing?

original: べっ、別にぃ？　\n何でもないわよっ
traducao: N-Nothing!\nIt's nothing at all!

original: あんたも色々大変なのねぇ
traducao: You've got it rough too, huh...

original: あれ……メガネが落ちてる。\nどこかで見た事ある様な……？
traducao: Huh... Someone dropped their glasses.\nI feel like I've seen these before...?

original: わぁ〜〜〜高そうなメガネ！\nなかなかおしゃれな作りしてるじゃない♪
traducao: Whoa, those glasses look expensive!\nThey've got a pretty stylish design, too~

original: ね。　ちょっと掛けてみちゃおっか？
traducao: Hey, maybe I should try them on?

original: えっ、そんなのまずいよ。\nだってそれ……
traducao: Wait, you shouldn't do that!\nThose belong to...

original: マ……マルタ？
traducao: M-Marta...?

original: ……どう？
traducao: ...Well?

original: え？　\nどう、って……\n似合ってるかどうかっていう、こと？
traducao: Huh?\nWhat do you mean 'well'...\nDo you mean if they suit you?

original: えっと……似合う……様な\nそうじゃない……様な……
traducao: Um... They kind of suit you,\nbut at the same time... they don't...

original: ウジウジしないで、はっきり言いなさいよ。\n自分の意見も言えないの？
traducao: Stop whining and spit it out!\nCan't you even express your own opinion?!

original: この豚が！
traducao: You pig!

original: ううん、違ったわね。\n豚には、自分の意志があるもの……。\nだからあなたは、豚未満ね
traducao: No, I take that back.\nPigs have wills of their own...\nSo you're less than a pig.

original: あ……あの……
traducao: U-Um...

original: 気安く話しかけないでくれる？\n豚のくせに！
traducao: Could you not talk to me so casually?\nYou're just a pig!

original: ご……ごめん……
traducao: I-I'm sorry...

original: どうしたら、許してもらえる……かな
traducao: What... can I do to make it up to you?

original: なぁに？\n豚の分際で、私の許しが欲しいの？
traducao: What?\nA mere pig wants my forgiveness?

original: そうねぇ……。\n「僕はあなたの豚です∀」って\n百万回言ったら考えてアゲル
traducao: Let's see...\nSay 'I am your pig' a million times,\nand I might consider it.

original: 百万回って……そんなの……
traducao: A million times... That's impossible...

original: 何？　私の言う事が聞けないの？
traducao: What? Are you defying me?!

original: だったら、さっさとどこか行っちゃえば？
traducao: Then why don't you just get lost?!

original: …………。\nわかったよ……
traducao: ......\nAll right...

original: ちょ、ちょっと……。\nほんとに行っちゃうの？
traducao: W-Wait...\nAre you really leaving?

original: ……もう！\n豚の分際で、私を置いてくなんて
traducao: ...Jeez!\nA mere pig dares to leave me behind?!

original: ……許さないんだからぁ！
traducao: ...I'll never forgive you!

original: ここにも、ない……か
traducao: They're not here either, huh...

original: ちっ……。\nどこに落としてしまったんだ。\nスペアがないと落ち着かん……！
traducao: Tch...\nWhere could I have dropped them?\nWithout a spare, I can't stay calm...!

original: あ〜ぁ……エミルぅ……
traducao: Aah... Emil...

original: マルタって、本当に\nエミルの事が大好きなんだね
traducao: You really do love Emil,\ndon't you, Marta?

original: えっ？
traducao: Eh?

original: う、うん……
traducao: Y-Yeah...

original: ほんとは、エミルと一緒に来たかった？
traducao: Did you want to come with Emil instead?

original: そんな……ダメだよ、こんな薄暗い場所で\nエミルと二人っきりなんて！？
traducao: No way! Being all alone with Emil\nin a dimly lit place like this?!

original: でも……。\nあぁ〜ん、どうしよう。\n私、エミルとだったら……∀
traducao: But still...\nOh, what should I do?\nIf it's with Emil...

original: えっと……。\nジョアンさんの事忘れてない？
traducao: Um...\nDid you forget about Joan?

original: はぁ〜、もう、エミル……∀
traducao: Haaah... Oh, Emil...

original: あんた達って、いつでもどこでも\nバカップルよねぇ
traducao: You two really are lovey-dovey morons\nwherever and whenever you go.

original: ね、エミルのどこらへんが\n好きなワケ？
traducao: Hey, what exactly do you\neven like about Emil?

original: 全部！
traducao: Everything!

original: 見た目も、容姿も、性格も声も……\nエミルのぜ〜〜んぶが大好きに\n決まってるじゃない∀
traducao: His looks, his appearance, his voice...\nObviously, I love absolutely\nevery single thing about Emil!

original: ベタ惚れねぇ〜〜〜
traducao: Head over heels, huh...

original: あたしは、あのウジウジ見てると\nいじりたくてムズムズするけど
traducao: When I see him moping like that,\nit just makes me want to tease him.

original: 何よ、ウジウジって
traducao: What do you mean, moping?!

original: 確かにエミルは根暗だし、卑屈だし\nたまに見てて苛々したりするけど
traducao: Sure, Emil is gloomy and self-deprecating,\nand sometimes it frustrates me to watch,

original: でも、それだって\nエミルの優しさとか、いいトコの\n表れなんだから！
traducao: Still, that's just proof of\nEmil's kindness and all of\nhis wonderful qualities!

original: は〜、なるほどねぇ
traducao: Hah, I see how it is.

original: そこまで言うなら、あんた本物だわ……
traducao: If you say that, you're the real deal...

original: えへへ。\nだってエミルは私の王子様なんだもん∀
traducao: Ehehe.\nAfter all, Emil is my prince!

original: ねえ、エミル？\n私の気のせいかもしれないけど……
traducao: Hey, Emil?\nMaybe it's just my imagination, but...

original: 最近、やけに走り込みしてない？
traducao: Haven't you been doing a lot of running?

original: あ、それわたしも気になってたんだ
traducao: Oh, I was wondering about that too.

original: 時々すれ違うけど\nかなり熱心にやってるよね？\n何かの修行？
traducao: I pass by you sometimes,\nand you're really working hard at it.\nIs it some kind of training?

original: いや……。\nそういうわけじゃないんだけど
traducao: No...\nIt's not really that, but...

original: この頃、戦闘から離脱する事が\n増えて来たから……。\n取り残されない様に、逃げ足の練習を……
traducao: Lately, we've been running from battle\nmore often...\nSo I'm practicing my running speed...

original: そういえば、合計の逃走回数が\n３０回を超えたって聞いたけど……
traducao: Come to think of it, I heard we've fled\nfrom battle over 30 times now...

original: それで走り込みなんかしてたの？
traducao: Is that why you've been running?!

original: う、うん……。\nみんなの足手まといになっちゃ\nいけないって思って……
traducao: Y-Yeah...\nI didn't want to become a burden\nto everyone...

original: なぁんだ。\nそうだったんだね
traducao: Oh, I see!\nSo that's what it was.

original: もう……、\n真面目なのか後ろ向きなのか
traducao: Jeez...\nAre you serious or just pessimistic?!

original: でも、それがエミルの\nいいところなんじゃない
traducao: Still, isn't that part of\nwhat makes Emil so great?

original: マルタもほんとは、わかってるくせに
traducao: You know that deep down too, Marta.

original: ハロルド！　\nお願いがあるの
traducao: Harold!\nI have a favor to ask!

original: 実は、みんなにナイショで\n作って欲しい薬があるんだけど……
traducao: Actually, there's a medicine I need,\nand it must be a secret from everyone...

original: あら。\nどんな薬をご所望？
traducao: Oh?\nWhat kind of medicine do you desire?

original: 毒薬？　\n睡眠薬？　\nしびれ薬？
traducao: Poison?\nSleeping pills?\nParalysis drug?

original: それとも超〜〜〜強力な\n惚れ薬かしら？
traducao: Or perhaps an ultra-potent\nlove potion?

original: じゃあ、惚れ薬で……∀
traducao: Then the love potion, please...

original: ……って、違ーーう！\nそうじゃなくって！
traducao: ...Wait, NOOO!\nThat's not what I meant!

original: な〜んだ、つまんない。\n違ったの？
traducao: Aw, how boring.\nThat's not it?

original: 最近、エミルの様子がおかしいの。\n怖い夢でうなされてるみたい……
traducao: Lately, Emil's been acting strange.\nHe keeps having terrible nightmares...

original: 何だか見てられなくて……。\n何とか出来ないかな？
traducao: I can't bear watching him suffer...\nIs there anything you can do?

original: そうねえ……
traducao: Well now...

original: 出来ない事もないけど
traducao: It's not entirely impossible.

original: 本当？
traducao: Really?

original: このハロルド博士に不可能の文字はないわ。\nま、どーんと任せといて♪
traducao: Nothing is impossible for Dr. Harold!\nJust leave it all to me!

original: やったあ！
traducao: Yay!

original: ハロルド、ありがとね！！
traducao: Thank you so much, Harold!!

original: 痛っ！
traducao: Ouch!

original: どうしたの、エミル！\n大丈夫！？
traducao: What's wrong, Emil?!\nAre you okay?!

original: あ、足の裏に……、\n何か刺さった……みたい……
traducao: S-Something... stabbed into...\nthe sole of my foot, I think...

original: え！！　\n見せて！
traducao: What?!\nLet me see!

original: ……、\nこれは、画びょう……？\n誰かが片付け忘れたのね
traducao: ...\nIs this a thumbtack...?\nSomeone must have forgotten to clean up.

original: ……、これでよしっ、と。\nもう、大丈夫だよ。　エミル
traducao: ...There, all done.\nYou're okay now, Emil.

original: ふぅ〜、ビックリした……。\n危ないなぁ、もう……
traducao: Phew, that scared me...\nThat was so dangerous, jeez...

original: 後で、ちゃんと\n消毒してあげるからね∀
traducao: I'll disinfect it properly\nfor you later!

original: ……うん。\nありがとう、マルタ
traducao: ...Yeah.\nThank you, Marta.

original: に、しても……誰よ、こんな所に\n画びょう置いていったの！
traducao: Still... who leaves a thumbtack\nlying around in a place like this?!

original: 見つけたらタダじゃおかないんだから！
traducao: When I find them, they'll pay for this!

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: エミル……まだ、よく眠れないの？
traducao: Emil... Still having trouble sleeping?

original: あ、ううん……そうじゃないんだ
traducao: Oh, no... That's not it.

original: どうも最近、\nもう一人の僕が勝手に出てきて、\nあちこち歩き回ってるみたいで
traducao: Lately, it seems the other me\ncomes out on his own\nand wanders around all over the place.

original: ええっ！？\nだって、戦闘中じゃないのに？
traducao: What?!\nEven when you're not in battle?!

original: クロエさん、ヒスイさん、\nスタンさん、アニー
traducao: Chloe, Hisui,\nStahn, and Annie...

original: これだけ目撃者がいるんだ、\n間違いないよ
traducao: With this many witnesses,\nthere's no doubt about it.

original: ハロルドの薬の副作用ってやつね……
traducao: A side effect of Harold's medicine...

original: うん……。\nハロルドさんは、そろそろ症状は\n落ち着いてくるって言ってたけど……
traducao: Yeah... Harold said\nthe symptoms should be calming down soon,\nbut even so...

original: 何か、僕……みんなの信用を\n一気に失った気分……
traducao: I feel like I've completely lost\neveryone's trust all at once...

original: そ、そんな事ないよ！\nもう一人のエミルだって、ちょっと\n荒っぽいってだけで、悪い人じゃないし
traducao: T-That's not true!\nThe other Emil might be a bit rough,\nbut he isn't a bad person!

original: そうかなぁ……
traducao: I wonder...

original: そういえば、\nまた新しい人が増えたみたいだね
traducao: Come to think of it,\nit looks like more people have joined.

original: あ……女の子になら、さっき会ったよ。\n道に迷ってたみたいだったから、\n案内してあげたんだけど
traducao: Oh, I met a girl earlier.\nShe seemed to be lost,\nso I showed her the way.

original: 何か、ふわ〜っとした\n不思議な感じの子で……
traducao: She had this airy,\nmysterious vibe about her...

original: あっ
traducao: Ah!

original: また会ったね、マルタ
traducao: We meet again, Marta!

original: コレット！？
traducao: Colette?!

original: ロイド。\nさっき話したマルタだよ
traducao: Lloyd.\nThis is Marta, who I told you about.

original: そっか。\nちょうど良かった
traducao: I see.\nThat's good timing.

original: これから挨拶に行こうと思ってたんだ。\nさっきは、コレットが\n世話になったみたいだな
traducao: I was just going to say hello.\nLooks like you helped Colette out\nearlier, huh?

original: 助かったぜ、ありがとな！
traducao: That really helped, thanks a lot!

original: い、いえ……
traducao: N-Not at all...

original: 俺、ロイド。\nコレットと一緒に、このギルドに\n参加させてもらう事になったんだ
traducao: I'm Lloyd.\nColette and I just joined up\nwith this guild.

original: これから、よろしくな
traducao: Nice to meet you from here on!

original: あ……僕は、エミルです。\nこちらこそ、よろしくお願いします
traducao: Ah... I'm Emil.\nThe pleasure is ours, nice to meet you.

original: エミルか。\n仲良くしてくれよな
traducao: Emil, huh?\nLet's be good friends!

original: それじゃ、\nそろそろ行こうぜ、コレット
traducao: Well then,\nwe should get going, Colette.

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: またね、二人とも
traducao: See you two later!

original: いい人達みたいだね。\n二人とも、話しやすそうで良かった
traducao: They seem like nice people.\nI'm glad they're both so easy to talk to.

original: そう？　\n……私はちょっと苦手かも。\nどうも調子が狂うっていうか……
traducao: You think so?\n...I'm not really good with them.\nThey kind of throw me off my game...

original: ……珍しいね。\nマルタがそんな風に言うなんて
traducao: ...That's unusual.\nFor you to say something like that, Marta.

original: そう……だよね。\nまだ全然、話した事もない相手なのに
traducao: Yeah... you're right.\nEven though we haven't talked much yet.

original: う〜〜ん。\nでも何だか、どこかで会ってたり……\n何かがあったりした様な……
traducao: Hrmmm...\nStill, I feel like we met somewhere...\nor like something happened...

original: あははは、そんな、まさか
traducao: Ahahaha, no way, that's impossible.

original: そうだよね……考え過ぎよね
traducao: You're right... I'm overthinking it.

original: でも、何か引っかかるなぁ……？
traducao: Still, something's bugging me...?
